ABOUT THE WORK

The fragile boundary
between seeing
and exposing.

A flower offers itself to you. Each petal is a boundary. Each removal, a small act of exposure.

At its center, a human presence sleeps. Unidentifiable. Silent. Defenseless. Does removing every exterior layer bring us closer to another being — or only to the limits of looking?

Mouse / touch: hold and pull a petal outward.
Keyboard: Tab to a petal, then Enter or Space.
Camera: pinch thumb and index finger, then pull.

Camera frames are processed on your device. Nothing is recorded or uploaded. Audio is optional.

A SIMPLE GESTURE

Pinch to hold.
Pull to uncover.

Allow your camera to move through the work with your hand. Bring your thumb and index finger together over a petal, then move your hand outward.

Live hand detection happens on your device. No recording. No uploads. No microphone.
